content.en: Researchers are exploring how algorithms can be used to control and improve the functionality of exoskeletons in physical rehabilitation. These algorithms are being used to control the movement of the exoskeletons, estimate joint angles, estimate human gait trajectories, provide assistance and rehabilitation control, and improve stability and accuracy. By harnessing the power of algorithms, scientists hope to enhance the effectiveness of exoskeletons in assisting with rehabilitation and improving the quality of life for patients.
content.da: Forskere udforsker, hvordan algoritmer kan bruges til at styre og forbedre funktionen af eksoskeletter i fysisk rehabilitering. Disse algoritmer anvendes til at kontrollere bevægelsen af eksoskeletterne, estimere ledvinkler, estimere menneskelig gangforløb, give assistance og rehabiliteringskontrol samt forbedre stabilitet og nøjagtighed. Ved at udnytte kraften fra algoritmer håber forskerne at forbedre effektiviteten af eksoskeletter i at assistere med rehabilitering og forbedre livskvaliteten for patienter.

critic.en: Exoskeletons controlled by algorithms? No thanks! How are we supposed to trust a device that relies on something as volatile and unpredictable as a computer program?
critic.da: Kan vi virkelig stole på, at algoritmerne altid vil prioritere patientens bedste?

potential.en: I mean, just think about it - technology is not just a tool we use; it's an extension of ourselves, our potential as humans. The idea of combining algorithms and exoskeletons to help people move and walk again is just mind-blowing. It's like a glimpse into a future where our physical limitations are no longer a barrier. I'm really excited to see where this research leads and how it can impact not just individuals, but society as a whole.
potential.da: Det er fantastisk at se, hvordan algoritmer kan anvendes til at optimere exoskeletter og gøre en reel forskel i rehabilitering. Denne teknologi har stort potentiale til at forbedre livskvaliteten for patienter og kan forhåbentlig bidrage til større uafhængighed og mobilitet. Jeg er virkelig begejstret for udviklingen indenfor dette område!
